dataTransformObject.name: Westerly_Customer_Name_Transform
dataTransformObject.label: Westerly Customer Name Transform
dataTransformObject.description: Daily batch copy of each customer full name from Westerly_Customers__dll into Westerly_Customer_Names__dll, mapped to Party Identification (type Full Name) so the unified profile Customer IDs card shows the name

model.input1.name: input1
model.input1.compiled_code: SELECT CONCAT(customer_id__c, '-name') AS Id__c, customer_id__c AS PartyId__c, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(first_name__c, ''), ' ', COALESCE(last_name__c, ''))) AS FullName__c, 'Full Name' AS PartyIdName__c, 'Full Name' AS PartyIdType__c FROM Westerly_Customers__dll WHERE first_name__c IS NOT NULL OR last_name__c IS NOT NULL
